issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named "_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)" (with a leading underscore), but both the template and the reference solution define and use "construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)" (without the leading underscore). This name mismatch is structural and will confuse students about which symbol to implement or call, and may cause tests or starter code to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to request construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) (remove the leading underscore), or change the template and solution to provide/expect _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...). As a backward-compatible alternative, add a thin alias in the template: def _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(*args, **kwargs): return construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(*args, **kwargs).
